capabilities: Open .txt files in a read-only view with stable line numbers and soft wrap toggle
Search within the file and navigate between matching lines
Filter to matching lines while preserving original line numbers
Report line, character, and byte counts plus line-ending and binary-content warnings
Cap rendering of large files to keep the view responsive
disambiguation: Not a text editor; it opens .txt files strictly read-only for inspection.
extras: States it makes no network requests, does not use the system clipboard, and intentionally avoids writing to disk in v0.1; installation via BRAT is supported for beta testing.
intentEvidence: It is not a text editor.
motivation: The author built it for quick inspection of plain text exports, AI output, notes from other systems, and generated files where opening a raw text file is not enough context.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated way to inspect plain text files with line context and search without risking accidental edits or slowdowns on large files.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .txt files with line numbers, in-file search, filtering, and large-file render caps.
